About

Clear diagnosis, clean cure.

Grims Studio operates at the intersection of medical science, offline-first software architecture, and user-centered interface design. Built on the ethos Clear Diagnosis, Clean Cure, its work applies scientific precision to both biological research and software engineering. It focuses on diagnosing real-world friction, from cellular damage caused by heavy-metal pollution to unreliable internet connectivity, and engineering targeted, durable solutions.

The studio's application suite prioritises privacy, local-first performance, and seamless user experience. Alongside software, Grims Studio leads digital media design and brand architecture, supporting academic publications like VOBS for the Association of Biomedical Sciences Students (ABSS) and commercial web layouts like The Pink Whisk.

Research & Leadership

Diagnosis first.

Research

  • Institution: University of Cape Coast (UCC), College of Health and Allied Sciences, Department of Biomedical Science
  • Degree: BSc Biomedical Science (2026)
  • Research: histopathological effects of heavy-metal contamination from illegal mining (galamsey) on biological tissue
  • Core disciplines: histopathology (tissue processing, fixation, staining, microscopy); chemical pathology (liver function tests, electrolyte disorders, metabolic acidosis); medical parasitology (helminth and protozoa morphology and life cycles)
  • Research tools: Zotero + Obsidian
  • Future goal: Teaching Assistant in the Department of Biomedical Science; exploring Master's programmes

Leadership

  • PRO & Media Coordinator, Association of Biomedical Sciences Students (ABSS), UCC: communications, event publicity, media strategy, official announcements
  • Founder & Lead, ABSS Editorial Board sub-committee: produces the weekly publication VOBS

Skills

  • Environment: Fedora Linux (KDE Plasma), custom desktop, power user
  • Languages & frameworks: Flutter/Dart, Rust (gtk4-rs), C#/WinUI 3, SkiaSharp, SQLite, HTML/CSS/JS
  • Design: Penpot, PureRef, digital art
  • Infrastructure: GitHub, GitLab, Supabase, CI/CD

Design Work

  • The Pink Whisk: commercial bakery website. Full UI design, layout architecture, and deployment strategy (pastry catalog, order/contact form, custom-pastry photo upload).
  • VOBS: weekly ABSS departmental publication, established and compiled by the editorial sub-committee.
  • Digital art: composite graphics, branding, and promotional design.
